notes.title: Major Demo Update 4.0 + Season of Pride 2024!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 

We’re delighted to announce [i]Of Sense and Soul[/i] is part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34979042/sale/SeasonOfPride2024?]Season of Pride 2024 Steam Sale![/url] 🥳🏳️‍🌈✨🏳️‍⚧️

Many thanks to Midboss, IGDA, and Gayming Magazine for featuring us in the 130+ queer games which make up this year's event. Be sure to check out the fantastic games (and deals) in store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276261/21ab8e3ca0163453cdb72545c89f5fd84bddd4e2.png[/img]

Work behind the scenes has been ongoing, as you can see from our monthly [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/forsythiaproductions/of-sense-and-soul-a-queer-victorian-romance-vn/posts]Kickstarter Backer Bulletins[/url], and you can actually see some of the newer game contents in the latest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231680/Of_Sense_and_Soul/]teaser trailer[/url] uploaded to the game's page.

Of course, [i]Of Sense and Soul[/i] isn’t for sale just yet, but I have the next best thing for you: [b]a new major demo update to tide you all over![/b]

[h1]Extended Demo Version 4.0: The Camera Update[/h1]

After over a year of continued development, it’s come time to put that experience to use on earlier scripted contents: as a result, [b]the Extended Demo has been given a cinematic makeover![/b]

If this is your first reintroduction to OSAS in some time, you can expect [b]more refined camerawork, additional scene direction, smoother transitions and improved dialogue pacing[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276261/e6737b1aef89f4c969afba775cdc0329be93293b.jpg[/img]

You’ll also be hearing more voice acting! [b]Introduction lines[/b] have been added for almost all the background characters, and [b]five new voiced scenes[/b] have been added to the demo. Enjoy even more of Seamus and James’ friendly rapport and a splash of Hugo and Camilla’s fond bantering!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276261/de719675055e2adaad1937369b1602aac8dba2fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276261/78f214234b70f06983d7fbf5b129a227c7bdd6e5.png[/img]

We hope you'll ring in this Season of Pride with us and enjoy playing this new demo update! 💖

———
 
[u]If you are redownloading, your save data should be intact, as the existing saves directory should not be affected by redownloading the game.[/u] Please let us know on Discord or in the comments if you encounter any issues!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2231680/allnews/]See the previous Version 3.0 Change Log here.[/url]

———

[h2]This update includes the following changes:[/h2]
[i]Major changes are in bold.[/i]

[h3]Visuals/Scripting ✨[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Overhaul to camerawork and dialogue pacing[/b] in demo contents.
[*] Hugo’s Bedroom Background has been added
[*] Minor adjustments to Sprite Assets
[/list]
[h3]Voice Acting ✨[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introductory voice lines added for most new character appearances
[*] Extra voiced scenes added to H1, S1, S2, and S4.
[/list]
[h3]Story ✨[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor grammar and dialogue line edits (Such as dropping the period after honourifics, the proper English way…)
[/list]
[h3]Misc. ✨[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated links on About page credits
[*] Updated demo ending screen
[/list]

———

[h1]Laundry List[/h1]
The Extended Demo remains largely feature-complete and no major updates are planned but the following future changes are in the works for an undetermined release date, further down the line as production continues:

[list]
[*] Addition of Coulston voiced scene to Hugo Chapter 3
[*] Extras Screen Fixes for the CG Gallery and Music Room
[/list]

notes.title: Ext. Demo Ver 3.0 + Kickstarter Countdown
notes.content:
Hello all!

Now that we've passed the 50% funding mark on our Kickstarter with a week to spare, we've got that new demo chapter at the ready as promised! In fact, it's already available for download here, right now. 

But first...

[h1]The Final Week of the Campaign[/h1]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/forsythiaproductions/of-sense-and-soul-a-queer-victorian-romance-vn]Our Kickstarter is just a week away from the finish line,[/url] and we're gearing up for that last push to get to 100%! The sooner we can reach 75% funded the better the odds are that we can make it to the goal—and you'll all get a Chapter 8 Voiced CG Preview with it. 

Seeing as the campaign is [b]all or nothing[/b], we need as much help as we can get to make it in the time that remains. Kickstarter only charges your card if the campaign is successful when the campaign itself ends, so you can always pledge early and not worry about funds being taken out immediately. 

(Tell your friends about the game if you like, too—sometimes that's how the best of hidden gems spread!)

No matter how you support us in developing OSAS, whether in big ways or small, thank you for being here with us! 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/forsythiaproductions/of-sense-and-soul-a-queer-victorian-romance-vn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276261/51ecf1cc34cfd83d6483e8fcdfa8ff3f901d3f31.png[/img][/url]
[i]Next funding milestone: At 75% funded, a chapter 8 voiced CG preview will be released.[/i]

[h1]Seamus Chapter 1[/h1]
This update brings with it Seamus Chapter 1, allowing you to play from the start of the game from either Hugo or Seamus' perspective!

The chapter was a lot of fun to write and script, and I hope you all enjoy this new look from Seamus' point of view! I think it drastically changes how his second chapter feels if you're playing from the very beginning. (If you were looking for more of James or Cornelius, they're also there!)

New assets such as Seamus' Dining Room background and Future Happiness, the soundtrack's affectionate theme, have also been included as part of this chapter.

You'll also get to see what Hugo wrote to Seamus in that very first letter! It's something deliberately unseen in Hugo's route, as Hugo himself writes it off as something he's sure he's "heard the last of", but it's something else entirely to Seamus.

Either way, we hope you enjoy this fresh content! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276261/36916cbc0a0602e7c94c11b775052b233ed44e25.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276261/f420b8698cf2929a2971019e912d135e05fbee0d.png[/img]

---

[u]If you are redownloading, your save data should be intact, as the existing saves directory will not be affected by redownloading the game. [/u]

Please let us know on Discord or in the comments if you encounter any issues!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2231680/view/3650778537201917890?l=english]See the previous Version 2.5 Change Log here.[/url]

[h1]This update includes the following changes:[/h1]
[i]Major changes are in bold.[/i]

[h3]Story✨[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Seamus Chapter 1 has been added! [/b]The insensitive button in the Prologue should now be selectable, meaning you can access the start of Seamus' route. Start a new game to get to it!
[/list]
[h3]SFX/Music✨[/h3]	
[list]
[*] [b]Added a new soundtrack[/b], Future Happiness (Affectionate Theme)! You can hear it at the end of Seamus Chapter 1.
[*] [b]New voice lines have been added to Seamus Chapter 2[/b] for the first meeting CG (the sparkly scene where Hugo is looking back at Seamus.)
[/list]
[h3]Visuals/Scripting✨[/h3]	
[list]
[*] [b]Seamus has two new poses[/b], one where he's reading a letter and another where he's holding his chin with a hand on his hip.
[*] [b]Seamus' Dining Room[/b] Background has been added!
[*] Camerawork has been updated for all chapters in the demo.
[/list]
[h3]User Interface[/h3]	
[list]
[*] The [b]Writing and Timed Choice Screen[/b] animations have been smoothed and finessed.
[*] The History screen has been revised to make it an easier reading experience.
[/list]

[h2]Laundry List[/h2]
The Extended Demo remains largely feature-complete and no major updates are planned but the following future changes are in the works for an undetermined release date, further down the line as production continues:

[u]Previously mentioned:[/u]
[list]
[*] Refresh of the Chapter 4 Poem-reading Scene CG
[*] Additional sprite elements for NPC sprites
[/list]

Happy playing! ✨

notes.title: Ext. Demo Ver. 2.5 + Kickstarter Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We've heard your feedback and seen your streams/videos of the demo, and it's so gratifying to hear you're all loving the demo and the added voicing. 

We're actually [b]just under three weeks away from the launch of the Of Sense and Soul Kickstarter[/b] now, and we couldn't be more excited or terrified! There are lots of preparations still to be made, including making sure the demo is in ship shape. And, well, the 2.5 update is here now, so it's on to the rest of the preparations for me!

Mark your calendars for July 12th or July 13th in your local time zone, because the campaign will start then and there!

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/forsythiaproductions/of-sense-and-soul-a-queer-victorian-romance-vn]Follow our Kickstarter Pre-Launch to be notified when it starts on Wednesday, July 12th at 8:00PM EST[/url][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276261/269ee2c40f6733d78fdb341e3c03e0e19d8a66e3.png[/img]

[h2]Audio Fixes[/h2]
The most prominent concern was for audio levelling, which we're now working with our audio engineer to resolve by balancing the full soundtrack itself. 

In the meantime, [b]quick fixes[/b] have been made to the tracks which were noticeably louder. The game should sound much better now, and those voiced scenes should come through beautifully even without touching the volume settings on your first playthrough!

---

If you are redownloading, your save data should be intact, as the existing saves directory will not be affected by redownloading the game. 
Please let us know on Discord or in the comments if you encounter any issues!

[h2]This update includes the following changes:[/h2]
[i]Major changes are in bold.[/i]

[h3]SFX/Music[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Temporary loudness fixes [/b]made to the following tracks: Bright Weather, Risky Affairs, Desire for Connection
[*] [b]Added a new soundtrack,[/b] Truth, Tenderness (Tranquil Theme) has been added! You can hear it in the voiced scene at the end of Chapter 4.
[/list]
[h3]Writing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Line added for clarification of Chapter 3 Journaling segment
[/list]
[h3]Scripting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor adjustments made to camerawork and transitions.
[*] Bug fix for demo ending where some players were redirected to Hugo Chapter 1.
[/list]
[h3]User Interface[/h3]	
[list]
[*] Minor edits made to the credits and preferences screens
[*] Button sound effects added back to the game menu navigation
[*] Buttons on the main menu and demo ending screen have been changed to include Kickstarter links.
[/list]

[h2]Laundry List[/h2]
The Extended Demo remains largely feature-complete and no major updates are planned but the following future changes are in the works for an undetermined release date:

[u]Previously mentioned:[/u]
[list]
[*] Refresh of the Chapter 4 Poem-reading Scene CG
[*] Additional sprite elements for all sprites
[*] Voice Line additions
[/list]
[u]New items:[/u]
[list]
[*] UI refinements for the gameplay menus (Timed Choices, Writing Composition Screens)
[*] Music Room and CG Gallery refinement
[/list]

Happy playing! ✨

notes.title: The OSAS Extended Demo Voice Update (Version 2.0) is here!
notes.content:
[h1]We're delighted to announce that the Extended Demo's Voice Update (Version 2.0) is now available![/h1]

We have been hard at work getting this update out to you all, and we are so pleased that you can finally see all the enhancements made to the game with the voicing and GUI we've made--among other things!

If you are redownloading, your save data should be intact, as the existing saves directory will not be affected by redownloading the game. 

Please let us know on Discord or in the comments if you encounter any issues!

[previewyoutube=OUleziPFIWA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h1]This update includes the following changes:[/h1]

[h2]Partial Voice Acting[/h2]
[list]
[*] Soundbytes/Bark Lines have been added for all characters.
[*] Fully voiced segments are now featured in Chapter 1, Chapter 2, and Chapter 4.
[*] Credits have been added to the About screen for our VAs and voice crew.
[*] Added sprite mouth voice line syncing so mouth animations play for the duration of voice lines instead of following dialogue display.
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Settings menu has now been updated to include a Voice Volume slider, complete with a dropdown menu to adjust individual characters' voices.
[*] A text box speaker icon indicator and  optional Voiced Scene Notifications have also been added to mark the start and end of voiced scenes.
[*] The Save/Load menu now has an Edit Saves function, which will allow you to delete unnecessary save files.
[*] The CG Gallery Extras menu is now functional.
[*] The dialogue and name boxes have been given higher contrast, and narration will display in a different box than dialogue.
[*] The chapter save prompt screen is now its own screen for saves only, and saving between chapters now displays the next title card as the save thumbnail image.
[*] A mouse cursor has been added for the ~aesthetic.~
[*] Revised the advert screen background to fit the text better.
[*] Fixed the Screenshake On/Off Setting so shaking actually does stop when it's on.
[*] Smoothed out dissolve transitions so the window doesn't hide every time a dissolve happens.
[*] Icons for keyboard and mouse game controls have been added to the Help Screen
[*] App Icon updated for Mac and PC
[/list]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] The completed version of the Crosby Hall background, featuring the full height of the background, has been included.
[*] Seamus' Chapter 2 CG (Hugo Enters) has been freshened up!
[*] New poses for Seamus' sprite
[*] Minor sprite fixes and edits to sprites' bases, mouths, and gaze directions.
[/list]

[h2]SFX/Music[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated versions of the following tracks are now in game: Sightline (Hugo's Theme), Bright Weather (Playful Theme), Risky Affairs (Tense Theme)
[*] A few sound effects have been added.
[/list]

[h2]Writing & Scripting[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some Britishisms and grammatical/punctuation errors have been corrected.
[*] Some camera movements have been smoothed and sound effects have been moved.
[*] Added an onboarding screen for the new voicing related UI features.
[/list]

[h1]Laundry List[/h1]
Although the Extended Demo is considered largely feature-complete and no major updates are planned, the following future changes are in the works:
[list]
[*] Refresh of the Chapter 4 Poem-reading Scene CG
[*] Additional sprite elements for all sprites
[/list]

Happy playing, and we hope you enjoy hearing [i]Of Sense and Soul[/i] come to life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276261/43f1e406475a66f55dcd158ec81e73d4fbbd92d8.jpg[/img]

[i]A doodle of Hugo and Seamus confused by recording equipment, from when recording for the Extended Demo began![/i]
​
